scripts.build: cd gfg-main && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const src=path.join(root,'gfg-main','dist'); const dst=path.join(root,'dist'); fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});"
scripts.build:dev: cd gfg-main && npm run build:dev && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const src=path.join(root,'gfg-main','dist'); const dst=path.join(root,'dist'); fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});"
